attchmntText: Ravinder Heights Limited has submitted it's Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the Quarter and Half Year ended September 30, 2026 along with Limited Review Report
voiceSummary: Ravinder Heights Limited announced that its Board of Directors approved the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the Quarter and Half Year ended September 30, 2026, on November 14, 2026. The standalone results show a loss after tax of 13.95 lakh for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to a loss of 10.82 lakh for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. The consolidated results indicate a loss after tax for the half year ended September 30, 2026. The financial statements have been reviewed by independent auditors Dewan P N Chopra & Co, who reported no material misstatements. The information is available on the company website www.ravinderheights.com.

attchmntText: Ravinder Heights Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Ravinder Heights Limited reported the outcome of its Board Meeting held on November 14, 2026. The Board considered and approved the Unaudited Standalone Financial Results for the Quarter and Half Year ended September 30, 2026. The Board also considered and approved the Unaudited Consolidated Financial Results for the same period. The meeting commenced at 03:15 P.M. and concluded at 03:45 P.M. The financial results are available on the company website at www.ravinderheights.com.
